blocks.title: Pilates
blocks.intro: Group Reformer, Strength, Ante and Postnatal, and Clinical Pilates at Mos Lane, Mosman Park.

blocks.text: From dynamic reformer classes to personalised clinical Pilates, every session is shaped by physiotherapists: how classes are programmed, how instructors are trained, and how each exercise is adapted to the person doing it.

items.title: Group Reformer
items.body: Full-body reformer classes. Each class opens with a warm-up, builds through a main session with one clear focus, and closes with individual stretching.

items.title: Strength
items.body: Reformer classes with more emphasis on load and progression, for people who want to train strength in a supported setting.

items.title: Ante and Postnatal
items.body: Reformer classes for pregnancy and the months after birth, programmed around each stage and taught by a physiotherapist.

items.title: Clinical Pilates
items.body: Up to four people with one physiotherapist. Each person works through their own program, set after an initial physiotherapy assessment.
items.meta: 60 minutes. Up to 4 people. Private health rebates available.

left.alt: Clinical Pilates studio with trapeze table
left.caption: Clinical Pilates Studio
left.description: Each person on their own program, with a physiotherapist in the room.

items.title: Trained to our standard
items.body: Every group reformer instructor completes the Together Wellness Pilates Training Program before leading a class: more than 80 hours of theory, practical assessment and mentored teaching, taught by physiotherapists.

items.title: A check-in before every class
items.body: Your instructor asks how your body is feeling and about any new or ongoing injuries. If something needs a closer look, we can book you in with a physiotherapist on the spot.

items.title: Adapted to you
items.body: Exercises are chosen with clinical reasoning and adapted to the person doing them. There is no single correct way to move, and we don’t teach as if there were.

items.title: Explained as we go
items.body: We tell you why each exercise is in the class, how to modify it and how to carry it into the rest of your week.
